profile.summary: Seeking to better the lives of individuals through applied software technologies; both new and existing.

positions.title: Software Engineer, (Engineering/Software Tools)
positions.description: Software Engineer for the Engineering/Software Tools Team at Crestron in Plano TX.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Sensor Software, Application Technology
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Design and maintain Qualcomm’s SensingHub framework on low-power AI DSPs, enabling real-time sensor data processing for smartphones, laptops, wearables, and automotive platforms (Snapdragon X1 & X2 Elite, 8 Gen 2/3, Elite (Original), Elite Gen 5 and future designs).

    - Drive performance and memory optimizations, including with work on Google Protocol Buffer for embedded with a focus on reduced latency, and memory footprint across critical system threads.

    - Lead memory analysis efforts by integrating Valgrind and AddressSanitizer into workflows, improving debugging coverage and reliability; commonly triaged memory and static analysis issues.

    - Collaborate cross-functionally with global modem, camera, and platform teams to align APIs and infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and delivery across SoC subsystems.

    - Designed, implementend, developed, served as POC, and collaborarated on (APIs /  Libraries / Services) to bring up and validate a inter-process communication (IPC) system to be used by the SensingHub for both internal and external use to drive a cross platform, scalable, low latency, low power solution for communicating sensor data between the framework and its clients. 

    - Built internal Python-based tools for CI, developer workflow automation, analysis tools, and most recently MCP servers supporting team-specific agentic AI tooling.

Tech Stack: C, C++, Python, Perforce, GCC/LLVM, Valgrind, AddressSanitizer, Klocwork, Protocol Buffers, NanoPB, Trace32, Agentic AI MCP Server
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Perforce · C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) · LLVM · Valgrind · Address Sanitizer · Protocol Buffers · Klockwork · NanoPB · Trace32 · MCP Server

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Rejoining Qualcomm under the same team as 2020 with the same responsibilities with the addition of contributing to other areas of the toolkit mentioned bellow. 

Sensor Software Test Team:

Role:
Responsible for designing and implementing a driver acceptance analysis tool that provides 
Qualcomm's engineers and partners working with sensor software and hardware with more insight 
into driver progression and or regression between driver versions. This will allow Qualcomm's sensor 
partners to better identify what areas of a driver needs more work while also providing the 
sensor software team an easier way to analyze incoming sensor drivers. 
   
Tool provides:
- statistical metrics, 
- graphing capabilities for visualizing collected data
- multi report analysis 
- and export of results into portable formats

Technologies:
- C# w/ .net
- Visual Studios
- HTML 
- XML w/ .net seralization

Remote Internship

positions.title: Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Focus on design, layout, assembly, test, and software/firmware development of InterFET test and development boards. 

Software was in charge of controlling hardware tests, logging statistical results, and controlling external lab test equipment with a network connection with SCIP.

Tools, Software Technologies: 
- Express PCB
- Schematic Capture  
- C / C++
- I2C
- SCIP

projects.title: Plano Academy HS: Titian Robotics Field Scouting App (IOS)
projects.description: For the 2016 FRC Competition, my team 5431 wanted a ipad App that would allow them to easily collect competition data on different teams and then compile that information flexibly to be analyzed by the team in multiple ways. This app works by having a set of forms that the user goes through to input observations about the competition and it then compiles that information for review later.

projects.title: Hack DFW Hackathon
projects.description:
Hack DFW Hackathon Project : Paperback (IPhone Book Store / Club App)

 Paperback is a app designed to to allow its users to read and converse about the books they read in a discussion form like fashion. Users can see what there friends are reading, make reviews and even share there books with others.
